description: Associates a Salesforce contact with an account by updating its AccountId, replacing any existing association. It can also update additional contact fields supplied in custom_fields.

account_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the account to associate the contact with.
account_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce ID of the account you want this contact to belong to. Pick the target account’s ID (it usually starts with 001) from the account record URL.
account_id.title: Account Id

contact_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the contact to associate with an account.
contact_id.human_parameter_description: The unique Salesforce ID of the contact you want to link to an account. You can copy it from the contact’s record URL (it usually starts with 003).
contact_id.title: Contact Id

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values to update on the contact. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Provide any custom contact fields to update along with AccountId. Use the API field name (ending in '__c') as the key.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

name: associate_contact_to_account

AssociateContactToAccountResponse.description:
Response for successful contact-to-account association.

HTTP 204 No Content - Salesforce returns empty body on successful PATCH.
Error responses (4xx/5xx) are handled via raise_for_status().
AssociateContactToAccountResponse.title: AssociateContactToAccountResponse
